Spacecraft name TEMUULEL
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher not launched
Organization National University of Mongolia
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Nation Mongolia
Operator In-house?
Partners Institute of Astronomy and Geophysics of Mongolian Academy of Science
Oneliner

The main goal of this mission is to take the picture of Mongolian landmass from space. 
Description

First domestically developed Cubesat. This project has four missions which include imaging the homeland from space, remote data collection, reprogramming a standardized interface board in orbit, and sending citizens’ wishes into space
